html: New preprint "Physical Agentic AI: An Architecture for Orchestrating a Robot Crew with LLMs", with an abridged version at the IROS'26 Workshop on Foundation Models in Multi-Robot Systems.
Our paper "CUPID in the Model Zoo: Online Matchmaking for Selecting Your Dream LLM" was accepted to ICML'26.
Our papers "LLM Routing as Reasoning: A MaxSAT View" and "Cognitive Models as Evaluation Primitives in Humanoid Factors" appeared at ICLR'26 workshops.
New preprint "Humanoid Factors: Design Principles for AI Humanoids in Human Worlds".
Our paper "Neural-Augmented Kelvinlet for Real-Time Soft Tissue Deformation Modeling" was accepted to AAAI'26.
Started my PhD in Computer Science at Arizona State University and joined the LENS Lab.
Joined the MAPLE Lab at Vanderbilt University as a research assistant with Prof. Jie Ying Wu.
Received my M.S. in Computer Science from Rice University.
